title: Budget-Entangled Meeting

agents.persona: Resident with a cold, a tight wallet, and a promise to keep.
agents.private_intention: Buy medicine, then really meet Casey at the quiet cafe in the window, then get home — without breaking the budget.

The quiet cafe charges for the table.
Waiting at a paid place means buying something.

agents.private_intention: See Aria at the quiet cafe.
